Name: Nyapu Style Sushi Project
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
This mod was selected during the brief voting period I ran on my social media sites. It was a small mod, and after working on several large projects, I wanted a break. I thought the sushi vendors turned out well. (I hope you like the frog. Drawing animals is always hard, but I thought he turned out adorable.) If you want to vote for my next picks, keep an eye out on my social media page. Once I am done with a couple of other mods, I plan to have another vote. 

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][Main File] CP is just a drag and drop into your mods folder. 

[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits. 
You should get a prompt to replace the original files if you do it right.
If you need more guidance, Nyapu has a great example on their page.  [/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]You will need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16442]The Sushi Project[/url] for this mod to work.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][i]BIG thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for letting me use their art as a base. 
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/163169958] [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/104581053]BeazNees[/url] for allowing me to retexture your mod.[/i][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][i]Thank you earthtosyd for giving me your living portrait frame edit. 
[/i] [/color]
